column1: # (CLOUD-SEVERANCE-P1) Egress allowlist — the ONLY hosts this fork may talk to
# beyond the cloud endpoints a later phase still has to remove.
# Format, one entry per line: <literal hostname><TAB><justification>
# Comments start with '#'. Read by scripts/check-cloud-severance.mjs, and frozen
# alongside it (scripts/ci-repair.sh FROZEN_GATE_PATHS) so a build-repair agent
# cannot widen it to make a failure go away.
# NOT listed, deliberately: the user's companion tunnel host. It is RUNTIME
# configuration and is never baked into an artifact, so a tunnel hostname
# appearing in a build is a real bug, not an expected entry.
# Also not listed: api.superset.sh, electric, streams and relay hosts. Those are
# still baked in phase 1 (sign-in and the data plane), which is exactly why the
# artifact assertions in the gate are phase-scoped rather than a blanket
